It reminded me of “Youth,” the song from the Korean TV drama Reply 1988. Swap first love and youth for Rose’s career, and it couldn’t fit better.

Youth blooms once more; at thirty, eyes brimming with tears.

------

Someday it will surely be gone, this green youth of mine

Like petals that open and fall

On moonlit nights, drifting past the window

My young love song, so full of sorrow

I reach for the days that are gone for good

But come back empty-handed, with only grief

Should I just let them go, or try to bring them back?

And so the years slip by

I can forgive you for leaving me behind

But it was the years that cast me aside

This hollow heart, with nowhere to rest

Has it gone in search of the dear playground of my childhood?
